newsitem.title: USA: Horizon Group Inc CEO steps down.
newsitem.headline: Horizon Group Inc CEO steps down.

text.p: Horizon Group Inc, a developer of retail outlet centers, said on Sunday Jeffrey Kerr has stepped down as chief executive officer, president and chairman so he could develop new business opportunities in sports and entertainment.
Kerr, a company founder, will continue as vice chairman and remain a major shareholder, the company said.
Ronald Piasecki, a Horizon director, will serve as interim president and chief executive officer, the company said.
Norman Perlmutter, a director of Horizon since 1995, was named chairman of the board, the company said.
